meta.purpose: Fixed texts for SPEC §6 translation notes. Keyed by Factoidal rewrite rule_id/variant_id (lean_rewrites), input_preparation step, and lean_rewrite_status. Placeholders in {braces} are filled from the parsed lean_replacement_query, never assumed.
meta.derived_from: mlp-all-queries.json lean_* fields; before/after comparison of examples; Lean sources in factoidal-core PR 917 (L4Factoidal/Wikidata/*.lean)
meta.corpus_counts: rule_id/variant_id counts over 580 queries are given per entry; 127 queries have no rewrite, 405 have one, 48 have two

rewrite-wikibase-label-service/automatic.what_changed: The WDQS label service (SERVICE wikibase:label) was replaced by explicit label lookups. Each ?xLabel / ?xDescription column the query selects is now computed in the query itself.
rewrite-wikibase-label-service/automatic.precise: {var}Label is {var}'s label in the first of these languages that has one: {label_languages}. If none has a label, it is {var}'s entity ID (e.g. Q42), or for a value that is not a Wikidata entity, its text form. If {var} is blank, {var}Label is blank.
rewrite-wikibase-label-service/automatic.precise_description: {var}Description is {var}'s description in the first of these languages that has one: {description_languages}. If none has one, it is blank (there is no fallback).
rewrite-wikibase-label-service/automatic.plain: Names are shown in {first_language} where available, otherwise in another listed language, otherwise as the item's ID.

derive.label_languages: the FILTER(lang(?{var}__label_value) = "..") values in order of appearance
derive.description_languages: the FILTER(lang(?{var}__description_value) = "..") values in order of appearance

rewrite-wikibase-label-service/automatic.observed: Language order is the author's list in order, duplicates removed, with 'mul' (the multilingual label) where the author listed it, otherwise appended last. Descriptions use the listed languages only; 'mul' is never added for descriptions.

rewrite-wikibase-label-service/manual.what_changed: The label service was used with explicit assignments (e.g. ?place rdfs:label ?birthplace inside the SERVICE). These became explicit lookups bound to the author's chosen column names.
rewrite-wikibase-label-service/manual.precise: {target} is {var}'s label in the first of these languages that has one: {label_languages}. Otherwise it is {var}'s entity ID, or its text form for a non-entity. It is blank if {var} is blank.
rewrite-wikibase-label-service/manual.plain: {target} shows the name of {var}, in {first_language} where available.

rewrite-named-subquery/default.what_changed: Blazegraph named subqueries (WITH { ... } AS %name, then INCLUDE %name) were restructured. Each INCLUDE is wrapped as a subquery that selects the named subquery's variables explicitly.
rewrite-named-subquery/default.precise: The named subquery %{name} is computed once and its results are joined in at each place it is included ({include_count} times).
rewrite-named-subquery/default.plain: Part of the query is worked out separately and reused.
rewrite-named-subquery/default.caution: The rewritten text still has a `WITH %name AS { ... }` prologue and `INCLUDE`, which are not standard SPARQL 1.1; the Wikimedia Java rewriter produces the same form. PR 917 documents a 'shared named-subquery alias issue'. mlp-192 (an alias inside a named subquery, `SELECT (?item1 AS ?item2) WHERE { INCLUDE %item1 }`) returned 20 rows on Blazegraph and 20456 on QLever in endpoint_audit. Do not claim equivalence for this rule; attach the audit result when one exists.

rewrite-legacy-select-alias/rename-input.what_changed: The original reused a variable name as the name of its own aggregate, e.g. (SUM(?stars) AS ?stars). Standard SPARQL forbids that, so the input variable was renamed (?stars → ?stars__wdqs_input).
rewrite-legacy-select-alias/rename-input.precise: In the original, ?{alias} named both the input values and their {fn}; here the input is ?{alias}__wdqs_input and ?{alias} is the {fn} only. Anything that sorts or filters on ?{alias} outside the aggregate uses the {fn}.
rewrite-legacy-select-alias/rename-input.plain: A technical renaming; results are unchanged.
rewrite-legacy-select-alias/rename-input.explain_as: the authored name ?{alias} for the aggregate; ?{alias}__wdqs_input is scaffolding

rewrite-query-hint/default.what_changed: A Blazegraph query hint (e.g. hint:Query hint:optimizer "None") was removed.
rewrite-query-hint/default.precise: The original contained a Blazegraph performance hint ({hint}); it was removed. Hints affect speed, not results.

rewrite-wikibase-isSomeValue/default.what_changed: The Blazegraph function wikibase:isSomeValue(?x) was replaced by a test on the form of the value: contains(str(?x), "wikidata.org/.well-known/genid").
rewrite-wikibase-isSomeValue/default.precise: {negated?not }an 'unknown value' {var}. 'Unknown value' is recognised by the form Wikidata gives such values (a generated identifier under wikidata.org/.well-known/genid).
rewrite-wikibase-isSomeValue/default.plain: {negated?Ignores|Only} cases where {var} is recorded as 'unknown value'.

rewrite-geof-distance/default.what_changed: Calls to the legacy distance function <http://www.opengis.net/def/geosparql/function/distance>, which WDQS's default geof: prefix pointed to, were changed to geof:distance in the standard GeoSPARQL namespace <http://www.opengis.net/def/function/geosparql/>, and any third (units) argument, which Blazegraph ignored, was dropped. A PREFIX geof: declaration was added.
rewrite-geof-distance/default.precise: ?{var} is the distance between {a} and {b} computed by geof:distance, in kilometres (F-GEODIST-UNIT).
rewrite-geof-distance/default.unit: kilometres: WDQS manual states kilometres; QLever's default is kilometres per its GeoSPARQL docs (see F-GEODIST-UNIT for verification status).

auto-language.precise: The original asked for the reader's interface language ([AUTO_LANGUAGE]); this version uses {language} (fixed when the query was prepared).

mediawiki-pipe-escape.precise: The query was stored on a wiki page with '|' written as {{!}}; this was converted back to '|' before translation.

rewritten.note: Explain lean_replacement_query. List the rule notes above.

unchanged.note: No translation was needed: the original is already standard SPARQL 1.1 as far as the rewriter is concerned.

skipped_unsupported.note: Not translated: the query uses a feature the target endpoint does not support. Stub record only.

unsupported_proprietary_service.precise: It calls a Blazegraph/WDQS-only service ({service}), e.g. the MediaWiki API (wikibase:mwapi).

parse_error.note: The original could not be parsed (original_query_parse_error). Stub record with the diagnostic.

endpoint_audit.note: Four queries carry endpoint_audit, comparing live Blazegraph and QLever results. When present and results_match is false, add: 'When tested on {date}, this version returned {q_rows} rows against {b_rows} for the original, and the rows did not match.' This reports what was measured and makes no claim about why.
